answer: Gate voting weight behind a fresh seed challenge that only unaffiliated third-party issuers can originate, each signature committed on-ledger for settlement checking. A valid seed is a pearl a single operator cannot mint for a thousand clones, because it controls none of the outside issuers scattered across the horizon; every new key needs a real issuer willing to seed it. A farm's self-issued credentials are a mere fable the origin check rejects, so no haven of fabricated seeds passes. The limit: an attacker who captures enough independent issuers to seed many keys.
